snippet.title: Mirage 7 | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Nadira and her loyal lizard Jiji as they embark on a perilous quest to uncover the secrets of the lost Princess Taishma, in the hopes of bringing her sister back from the dead. 

Coming to Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, PlayStation and Xbox on March 6.
